notes.title: Hotfix 1.43
notes.content:
This is a small hotfix related to the anomaly.

After defeating the boss from the secret islands discoverable anomalies will be added in Arctic, Asia, and Desert. Each now shows "Click?" when you hover over the anomaly, suggesting the player to click on it.

Once anomalies can be discovered the main menu shows a numeric indicator for the amount you have discovered per stage.

The anomaly secret (once discovered) can now be used as a shortcut to enter the anomaly stages. 

That's it for this hotfix!

---

There is still a big backlog for additions, etc. However due to a busy personal schedule I will only prioritize critical issues that either lock you out of gameplay content or affect the achievements. This was a hobby project and I am very happy with the positive reception. I am working on a much bigger project that will be publicly announced soon.

notes.title: Patch 1.41
notes.content:
This is a small patch to address some of the issues that have been existing for some time now whereas others were quite new. 

Here is a little list of things that got fixed:
[list]
[*] Baarn Yard timer fixed (pushes correct time to highscores).
[*] Baarn Yard fastest time highscore reset due to 0 second entries.
[*] Speedrun achievements no longer trigger at boss stage when you die.
[*] Fixed win rare case of win condition not being triggered.
[*] Increased the size of The Cube by 2 in each dimension. The Cube is now 7x7x7 instead of 5x5x5. The effective puzzle area is still 5x5x5. You will understand why this was needed once you play it.
[*] Significantly improved The Cube to be not luck dependant once you figure out the starting strategy.
[*] Removed starting marker for The Cube in order to remove a ton of the RNG. Every first click is safe!
[*] Made difficulty stars more prominent so that you know how difficult each puzzle is (it is within the stars at each level). The lower the number, the easier the puzzle is. 
[/list]
If you haven't done so already make sure to check out the forums! There is a list on there with things that I am currently working on. 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1196300/discussions/0/3819659084192872866/


Thank you all for providing so much feedback!

notes.title: RTX Sweeper - The Anomaly
notes.content:
[h1]The Anomaly[/h1]
This update took a while and contains a lot of juice to make it worthwhile. Not only did it get some much needed quality of life improvements, but a brand new environment as well.

This environment can only be unlocked after defeating the boss. Once you have defeated the boss you might want to revisit the first 3 stages in order to find traces of odd objects that don't belong there. [i]Make sure to [b]click[/b] on them once you spot them![/i]

As usual there will be 3 sections through which the changes will be addressed.

[h2]Added[/h2]
The focus of this update was the new environment; The Anomaly. This environment is hardlocked behind progress, so you won't even get to see it unless you have beaten the boss. That being said, those that have got the skill and patience will be rewarded with plenty!
[list]
[*] Cube WASD movement controls
[*] The Anomaly (new environment)
[*] Anomaly puzzle 1
[*] Anomaly puzzle 2 (new mechanic)
[*] Anomaly puzzle 3 (new mechanic, boss tier puzzle)
[*] [i]Subtle[/i] environmental Anomaly unlocks (only appears after defeating the boss at least once)
[*] 2 brand new achievements
[*] Steam leader boards dedicated to the new environment
[*] Steam stats for the new environment
[*] All puzzles now show their individual names during the selection stage
[/list]

[h2]Updated[/h2]
From the community there were quite a few requests for improvements on mainly the Cube. Please do keep the feedback coming. The puzzles are all designed for you to enjoy. Crucial feedback will be implemented (some sooner than others).
[list]
[*] Cube readability by removing wireframe and changing the numeric color states. The numbers adjacent to the tile you are hovering over change in color so that you can understand more easily which number is connected to which tiles
[*] Improved dialogues
[*] Quicker response time when resetting puzzles (especially larger ones)
[*] Cube starting tile is a lot more prominent
[*] The store page has been revamped as well
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
In order to prepare the game for the next update (||settings||) a lot of fixes had to take place and at the same time some new bugs were discovered due to this. 
[list]
[*] RTX performance improvements should produce less artefacts with a slightly higher frame rate (applied to levels Arctic, Asia, Islands, Desert, Menu, and Tutorial, other levels had no issues)
[*] Bug where screen rarely turns black for a couple of frames during cutscenes
[*] Bug where you can accidently place 2 flags at once
[*] Bug where tiles in extremely rare and specific circumstances do not detect a flag (nearby or on top, eg. marking bombs)
[*] Bug where difficulties were not calculated properly
[*] Small code refactor that destroyed a few bugs
[*] All DLC locked icons link to DLC now
[*] Outlines for all texts are more snappy now
[/list]

With all that being said, make sure to enjoy the good new content!

notes.title: Patch 1.301
notes.content:
Hello there!

I had received a few reports highlighting some of the issues with Galaxy, the new achievements etc. Due to this I investigated it and found a couple of bugs that have been patched with this small update:
[list]
[*] Galaxy stats are all being tracked properly now (eg. tileclicks, games played, etc.)
[*] New achievement should trigger now when you complete the puzzle in Galaxy
[*] Galaxy victories are being saved properly now

[/list]

Yes that's it, just a couple of things, but I wouldn't have found it with the feedback, so thank you all!

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Upping the standards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42008331/f5fbbf1e7a72160ec42e888c8cb05ff316ef156f.png[/img]

[h2]Hey there, curious about the new juicy content? You've come to the right place! In here we will cover everything that has been added, including a fresh [b]new DLC[/b].[/h2]

[h3]Now let's first start with the list of added things[/h3]
- Localisation (buttons, cutscenes, etc.)
- Language selection setting
- Multiple languages by the power of Geoffrey and Google translate (I need money for translators and up to this point this game generates no revenue lol)
- 3D sweeper orientation controls through middle mouse button
- DLC (see DLC section at the bottom for what it contains)
- More reflective spots in the game for RTX
- New UI assets thanks to Nathalie
- Settings are accessible in game as well
- Prevents accidental clicks when entering settings
- Can toggle RTX in game now when launched in DX12 mode
- Galaxy ambient music
- New achievement
- Bugs for more work in the future

[h3]A lot of things got updated as well[/h3]
- Credits
- 3D sweeper playability
- 3D sweeper readability
- 3D sweeper starting tile is always empty block instead of number (small chance for number though)
- Better water caustics where required
- Some puzzle visual improvements in Asia
- Names of certain buttons
- Dialogues to be more fitting content wise
- UI menu to be more organized
- UI in game to be more organized
- All UI assets to be fresh and professional
- Changed main font to Arial for full localisation integration
- Made tiles a bit reflective 
- Galaxy music is a bit more... intense

[h3]The list of things that got fixed[/h3]
- Numbers background
- Numbers colors
- [b]All[/b] known 3D Sweeper bugs (Galaxy level)
- Several materials with shading glitches
- Speedrun achievements now only trigger when you win
- UI scaling in multiple (pretty sure it works in all) aspect ratios (eg. 16:10 and 4:3 should now show a normal UI)
- Inactive internet connection should no longer cause issues
- You can no longer accidently click on tiles while adjusting settings
- Running in DX12 enables RTX settings and running in DX11 shows how to enable RTX settings
- Inaccurate skill percentage when completing level
- Sometimes game completion not being saved

[h3]DLC - Customization[/h3]
This DLC is focused on customization. This DLC will also gain more additions over time, where as the price will also increase properly. So yes, this is not a free DLC. The main purpose is to support the dev (yes, that is me) and to generate a bit of revenue for higher quality updates.
- You can create a custom flag color
- Added multiple new flags to choose from and play with
- New levels: [b]Garden[/b] and [b]Garden Plus[/b]
- Garden, for the sake of your PC this is not unlimited, but allows you to be creative with the grid generator
- Garden Plus, want to stick to 2D but with more challenges? This is pretty much as unlimited as it will get, generate your own crazy grid! Warning, extremely large grids can cause the game to freeze or crash depending on the specs of your system.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2166670/RTX_Sweeper__Unlock_Customization/?curator_clanid=42008331

[h3]Final words[/h3]
In order to be able to launch the game with RTX options, make sure to launch it through Steam while also ticking the DX12 option.

I want to finish this patch note with a shout-out to two people that have helped me a lot with this update.

The localization tool was made by Geoffrey due to which I can support a lot languages now. They might or might not be grammatically accurate, but at least it's a start. The revenue from the DLC should help me to hire proper translators eventually.
[b]Geoffrey Hendrikx[/b] - HendrikxCoding

The UI overhaul was done by Nathalie. She improved the UI flow in a lot of ways. The most noticeable will be the visuals, but also the significantly fewer amount of clicks.
[b]Nathalie Verduin[/b]

You have come to the end, thank you for reading it and hopefully you will have a blast with the new features!

[i]To celebrate this update and the launch of the DLC there will be a little launch discount. What are you waiting for? Get sweeping![/i]

notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42008331/eec738f7df271e9e393c823b0e9389f4b9fc8f6d.jpg[/img]
Heya!

Once you have unlocked all areas your default Menu will look like the image above... and that is without ray tracing! This update brings to you some long awaited additions both internally and externally. 

So let's get started with the [b]new stuff[/b]:
[list]
[*] new logo
[*] UI cube controls (improves readability)
[*] water caustics where it matters
[*] reflections in some areas for non RTX graphics mode
[*] [url=https://www.speedrun.com/rtx_sweeper]officially added on speedrun.com![/url] 
[*] [url=https://www.igdb.com/games/rtx-sweeper]An official category for platforms such as Twitch![/url]
[/list]

RTX Sweeper got finally approved on various websites, which means that there is a lot more competition await for those eager to dominate the leader boards. I have a lot more future plans for you guys related to this, but no spoilers for now!

[b]Updated[/b]:
[list]
[*] boss shuffle mechanic has been reverted to the original mechanic to be less confusing
[*] changed tutorial flight path for some fixes (more coming to this though)
[*] the cube layering system has been removed to improve readability
[*] the skill percentage is extremely accurate now for the better
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]:
[list]
[*] fixed empty UI spots
[*] fixed fonts in the Galaxy
[*] achievement "a taste of misery" should be unlockable immediately after triggering it
[/list]

It was a small, but necessary update. Over time I will be rolling out some more small updates that tackle some of the current issues in the game related to RTX performance and lighting. More puzzles will be added as well in both the Secret Islands and the Galaxy. The single puzzles there are just to give you a taste about what is to come. 
I will be adding some easter eggs... on steroids, to fit the overall theme of the game. I will announce it when this is released since it requires a lot of preparations. 

Enjoy the update and until next time!

notes.title: The Fanatics Update
notes.content:
Well hello there, today the fanatics update has been launched! This update focusses on some quality of life improvements based on feedback from the community. Don't worry more is planned in the future, this is just the start. 

The fanatics update is about making the game more competitive and the new additions will show you this! The game is also under review at speedrun.com for official speedruns. This process can take up to 4 weeks, so once it gets approved there will be an announcement for it. 


So let's start with the new stuff. This is what has been added:
- steam achievements!*
- steam leaderboards!*
- steam statistics (you can't see them all though)
- you can skip cutscenes by pressing spacebar
- shows version number when you win
- "Galaxy" -> a completely different boss battle

* You can access the achievements and leaderboards through for example your library. In there you can see your stats and compare it to the global stats. The leaderboards can be compared to your friends or globally, so have fun with it!


There were a lot of quality improvements that had to be made. Some of those you might recognize others you might not. 
Updated:
- buttons in main menu are hidden instead of unclickable
- area select is 10 times faster, more efficient and doesn't repeat dialogue
- removed area buttons in tutorial
- efficiency calculator more accurate, easier to predict, and consistent
- secret islands boss mechanic slightly adjusted
- slight dialogue changes
- submitted for speedrun.com


There were some issues from which some were more annoying than the others. There are still quite a few that I want to fix. I haven't had the time yet to work on it though. I did fix the following:
- lighting in tutorial level
- starting tile in arctic is now more prominent
- game is back in full screen
- new formula for calculating difficulty
- heavily reduced chance of getting unsolvable puzzles (aka guessing, 50/50s etc)
- bugs when saving scores at certain levels


So that's all cool and exciting, but there are still some things mention worthy on my to-do list. 
- game optimization for ray tracing, I want to add more accurate custom algorithms to make the quality better while reducing the load on your system
- easter eggs, I got a whole bunch planned for you, some really crafty ones! They will be rolled out over time, did you manage to find the current existing ones?
- localization based on player base however this is unfortunately not cheap so...
- DLC's, mainly to support me so that I can expand on the game. 
- new visual effects 
- reactive environments with more animals


For now this is it, I hope you all will enjoy it. There is more to come, but I am a solo dev so updates will be slow paced, thank you for understanding!

notes.title: First update postponed by 3 weeks
notes.content:
Hi.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42008331/c64dd6b54da64443d99be301dc98dfcf2ad30606.jpg[/img]

[h2]First update[/h2]
So the first update is a big one. It will add new content, it will fix bugs and it will improve a lot of things by quality of life changes. At the bottom you can find a small list of what is waiting to be rolled out! There is also a little part about an extra feature that I will be releasing this update as well to compensate for the long waiting time. Overall the update is meant to improve the overall user experience. 

[h2]Why delayed?[/h2]
Unfortunately my laptop has died. It is the only device I have with a ray tracing capable card. My computer has an older graphics card. This means that I am unable to create a game build that supports ray tracing from my computer. One might say that I can upload the ray tracing version later on, but that would defeat the purpose of "RTX" in RTX Sweeper, hence why I choose to delay it instead. 

According to the spokesperson it can take up to 3 weeks for the repairs, which might or might not include shipping... she was very uncertain about it. Either way, shipping won't make the waiting time that much longer. 

[h2]What can you expect?[/h2]
So I already have a ton of new things ready and waiting to be released. However since I gained 3 weeks of extra time before the release, I might as well add a little nifty extra to it. I should be able to finish it in the given time, since most of the underlaying architecture has been there since pretty much day 1. Either way here are a few small lists with what you can expect:
[list]
[*] the game can now be played in full screen again (with ray tracing as well)
[*] added achievements
[*] added leaderboards
[*] skippable cutscenesssss
[*] eliminated almost all chances of getting stuck on 50/50s
[*] and much much muuuch more!
[/list]

[h2]New thingy?[/h2]
So yeah... I added a new environment. Well not exactly an entire new environment like Asia and all that, but it is a new level that you unlock after beating the boss at least once. So why after the boss battle and not before? Because I will be upping the difficulty. This has a singular puzzle (for now) and this will introduce 3D sweeper. Solving puzzles in not only the x and z dimensions but also the y dimension. Normally the max amount of bombs a tile could get was 8, not it is 26... theoretically speaking. More on that when the update lands! Currently it is a work in progress. So stayyy tunedddd.

Lastly but not least, the update will be released around the last week of may.

Good luck with the puzzles and until then!
